However, the ground truth explicitly states that the ropes were drawn in the order: white (1st), blue (2nd), green (3rd), red (4th). The model failed to recognize that multiple lines can be drawn within the same frame (Frame 11) and misassigned red as the third line based on its first visible appearance rather than its actual drawing sequence. This reflects a misinterpretation of temporal progression and drawing order.
